Read my story about the Oculus Go #2nd GDC Goal Achieved: Oculus Go hands on! Micah Blumberg writes for Silicon Valley Global News and is reporting from GDC 2018 medium.com

The VR Community on Facebook vividly remembers Unity’s Vision Summit in 2016 when everyone in attendance got a VR headset for free. We also remember when Oprah gave everyone a free car.
